BrochureContent.Content:
A truly impressive detached home extending to approximately 342 sq.m, set in an elevated position at Tullyhumphrys, The Pigeons, Athlone, Co. Westmeath. This exceptional property enjoys a wonderfully peaceful rural setting, with sweeping views across the surrounding countryside, while remaining within easy reach of Glasson and Athlone. 
The property is situated just outside the picturesque village of Glasson, renowned for its excellent pubs, restaurants and welcoming village atmosphere. Glasson Lakehouse, Hotel Golf Club is also located nearby, offering a beautiful lakeside setting, restaurant facilities and golf. Quigley?s Marina is also close by, providing access to the beautiful waterways of Lough Ree and the River Shannon. 
Athlone town is approximately a 20-minute drive, providing convenient access to a wide range of shops, services, restaurants and transport links. 
Internally, the house offers exceptionally generous and versatile accommodation with an excellent flow throughout.
On entering, the impressive entrance hall leads to a beautiful lounge with vaulted ceiling and exposed timber beam features, dual-aspect windows and a striking marble-surround fireplace incorporating a solid fuel stove. The room is exceptionally bright and enjoys lovely views. 
The large kitchen/breakfast room is a particular feature of the property, with extensive fitted units, a bay window and a charming dining area with table and chairs positioned within the bay. Double doors lead through to a formal dining room, which in turn opens to a sunken family room with a wood-burning stove, creating a wonderful space for relaxing and entertaining.
Also located off the entrance hall is a versatile home office/music room, while a separate corridor leads to a ground-floor bedroom, bathroom and large utility room.
Upstairs are a further four generously proportioned bedrooms, including an impressive master bedroom with a fully fitted walk in wardrobe and ensuite bathroom. The first floor also benefits from a spacious family bathroom serving the additional bedrooms. Fully furnished. No pets.
Outside, the elevated position provides a wonderful sense of space, privacy and tranquillity, with sweeping views over the surrounding Westmeath countryside.
The location offers an excellent combination of peaceful country living with easy access to Glasson, Lough Ree, local dining, golf, boating and Athlone town.
Email all enquiries to info@hynes.ie along with references. 

Disclaimer:
REA Hynes has taken every care in the preparation of these particulars; however, all information is provided for guidance only and prospective tenants should satisfy themselves as to its accuracy. 

Outside
The property occupies an impressive site of approximately 4,400 sq.m. (just over one acre) and enjoys an elevated position with sweeping views across the surrounding countryside. The generous grounds provide excellent privacy and a wonderful sense of space. There is ample parking to the front and side of the house, together with a useful detached storage shed/outbuilding to the side. To the rear, the property benefits from a private patio area, ideal for outdoor dining, entertaining or simply enjoying the peaceful surroundings. The gardens are complemented by established flower beds and planted areas, adding colour and character to the grounds. Overall, the outside space is a particularly attractive feature of the property, offering a tranquil rural setting while providing generous and practical outdoor areas.

An exceptional and spacious detached home extending to approximately 342 sq.m, occupying an elevated position with wonderful sweeping views over the surrounding Westmeath countryside.

This superb property offers exceptionally generous accommodation arranged over two floors, with five bedrooms and a combination of impressive reception and living spaces. The property has a particularly attractive layout, making excellent use of its generous floor area.

The entrance hall leads to a magnificent lounge featuring a vaulted ceiling with exposed timber beams, dual-aspect windows and a beautiful marble-surround fireplace with solid fuel stove. The large kitchen/breakfast room is another standout feature, with extensive fitted units, a bay window and dedicated dining area. Double doors lead through to the formal dining room and onwards to a family room with wood-burning stove.
A versatile home office/music room, ground-floor bedroom, bathroom and large utility room complete the ground-floor accommodation.
Upstairs are four further bedrooms, including a superb master bedroom with ensuite and fully fitted walk-in wardrobe, together with a spacious family bathroom.
The elevated setting provides a wonderful feeling of space and tranquillity, with beautiful uninterrupted views across the surrounding countryside. Despite its peaceful rural location, the property is conveniently positioned just outside Glasson village, famous for its pubs and restaurants, and is close to Glasson Lakehouse, Hotel & Golf Club and Quigley's Marina. Athlone town is approximately 20 minutes away by car.
A rare opportunity to lease a substantial and beautifully presented home in a truly special countryside setting. Early viewing is highly recommended.

 ullyhumphrys, The Pigeons is ideally located in a beautiful and peaceful countryside setting, close to the village of Glasson and within easy reach of Athlone.

The picturesque village of Glasson is just a short drive away and is well known for its welcoming village atmosphere, traditional pubs and excellent restaurants. Glasson has a number of highly regarded dining establishments, including Grogan?s of Glasson and The Villager, with further dining and leisure facilities available at Glasson Lakehouse and nearby Wineport Lodge.

For leisure and recreation, Glasson Lakehouse is located nearby on the shores of Lough Ree and offers an internationally recognised 18-hole parkland golf course, restaurant and leisure facilities. The scenic golf course overlooks Lough Ree and Killinure Bay.

Quigleys Marina at Killinure Point is also nearby, providing access to the beautiful waterways of Lough Ree and the River Shannon, making the area particularly attractive for boating, fishing and water-based activities.

There are numerous opportunities for walking, cycling and enjoying the surrounding countryside, with Portlick Millennium Forest and the shores of Lough Ree providing particularly scenic recreational areas. he property enjoys an idyllic countryside setting while being conveniently located close to Glasson village and approximately 20 minutes from Athlone. Glasson is renowned for its traditional pubs and excellent restaurants, with Glasson Lakehouse, Hotel & Golf Club and Quigley?s Marina at Killinure Point also located nearby. The area offers excellent opportunities for golf, boating, fishing, walking and cycling, with Lough Ree and Portlick Forest close at hand.
Local schools include Tubberclare National School (Scoil Naomh Clár), Ard Na Grath National School, Drumraney National School and Tang National School, with further primary and post-primary schools available in Athlone. Glasson Preschool is also located in the village.
Location: Tullyhumphrys, The Pigeons, Athlone, Co. Westmeath, N37 F344
